Title: Address checkout price-discovery gap
Scope: Shipping estimate and tax preview on cart; uncheck marketing opt-in; remove Company field where Shopify permits.
Acceptance: Accurate regional estimates; event QA; checkout regression and rollback checks.

Title: Add free-shipping progress bar and upsells
Scope: Dynamic threshold progress and curated accessory add-ons; collapse order notes.
Acceptance: Approve threshold economics and eligibility; verify product matching, mobile layout and totals.

Title: Expand Remarkety email flows
Scope: Post-purchase cross-sell; 60/90/120-day win-back; VIP early access; browse abandonment.
Acceptance: Validate consent, suppression, triggers and feeds. Flow delivery is distinct from observing mature win-back results.

Title: Review and implement Meta retargeting shift
Scope: Audit recommendation: shift Meta emphasis from purchase campaigns to traffic/awareness and cart-abandonment retargeting.
Acceptance: Validate tracking, attribution, audience sizes and commercial approval before changing budgets; channel averages alone do not establish causality.

Title: Add exit-intent popup and trust signals
Scope: Non-discount gift-message/save-cart offer and reassurance near checkout.
Acceptance: Verify actual returns and delivery policies before publishing claims; validate dismissal, keyboard and mobile behavior.

Title: Scale Google Search and add BNPL
Scope: Evaluate Performance Max and branded/category keywords; integrate Klarna or Afterpay if approved and eligible.
Acceptance: Approve fees, merchant eligibility, contribution margin and campaign controls; QA payment and refund flows.
